articles.title: Ondo Finance debuts SEC-aligned tokenized stock model with BlackRock ETF, Micron shares
articles.snippet: Broadridge and transfer agent Oasis Pro underpin a new structure that keeps tokenized securities within existing U.S. market rules, based on the SEC's third-party custodial model.

articles.title: A struggling Nasdaq-listed company that tried to copy Saylor's Bitcoin playbook is completely dumping crypto for AI
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed Korean media company once lined up $1 billion in financing to buy 10,000 bitcoin. A recent filing confirms its balance is now zero as it pivots to AI infrastructure and fights to stay listed.

articles.title: Bitcoin rises 4% to above $61,000 as inflation fears soften
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rose after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation risks had eased. A 7.9% drop in South Korea's Kospi on renewed AI chip worries did little to dent the bid.

articles.title: FBI Director Kash Patel caught sleeping on required disclosure of six-figure MSTR investment: Report
articles.snippet: Patel loaded up on BTC-holder MSTR shares but failed to file a timely disclosure, according to a report by nonpartisan news outlet NOTUS.

articles.title: Ether, solana, dogecoin in the green after Warsh comments push bitcoin above $60,000
articles.snippet: Bitcoin climbed back above $60,000 for the first time in over a week after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation risks had come down. Solana led the majors, up about 16% on the week, while a semiconductor selloff hit Asian markets and dented the AI trade that has pulled capital from crypto all quarter.
